title: Hive Strike
author: ZadenZ
description: Arena shoot-em-up: blast the swarm through 15 stages and three Queen boss fights, or chase a high score in Endless. Native 3DS port of the Save Point arcade game with power-ups, per-mode high scores, and an original synth soundtrack.
long_description:
Hive Strike is a fast arena shooter. Clear 15 stages in STAGES mode - a Queen boss waits every 5 stages - or survive wave after wave in ENDLESS.

There is no auto fire in the 3DS version, by design: tap A or B for one shot, hold for a stream, with the same shots-in-the-air cap as the original. Pick up Twin, Spread, Shield and Bomb power-ups to turn the tide.

Features:
- 4 enemy types plus Queen bosses at stages 5, 10 and 15
- Separate high scores for STAGES and ENDLESS, saved to the SD card
- Touch-screen menus, dashboard and a big hold-to-fire FIRE button
- Synthesized sound effects and bass-line music, toggleable on the title screen

Move with the Circle Pad or D-Pad. START pauses, SELECT exits to the Homebrew Launcher. The .cia installs to the Home Menu; the .3dsx runs from the Homebrew Launcher.
